notes: The proposed axes are designed to capture various aspects of the learning process in a structured manner.
Task type (task_type) includes single-task, mixture, and curriculum position.
Data modality (data_modality) encompasses image, token-text, numeric series, tabular data, graph, audio, and control signals.
Temporal structure (temporal_structure) covers independent identically distributed (IID), sequential, and delayed sequences.
Value type (value_type) distinguishes between discrete, continuous, and mixed types of values.
Latent dimensionality (latent_dimensionality) ranges from small to large.
Noise level (noise_level) is categorized as low, medium, or high.
Recurrence pattern (recurrence_pattern) specifies whether recurrence is marked, chaotic, based on grammar depth, or absent.
Sample size (sample_size) can be tiny, small, medium, or large.
Time series stationarity (time_series_stationarity) indicates if the time series is stationary or non-stationary.

batch1.input_includes: the provisional AXES schema from geode.descriptor
batch1.role: Propose a refined task-descriptor axis set with attribute vocabularies, given the provisional schema. Output STRICT JSON only: {"axes": {"axis.name": ["token", ...]}, "notes": ["..."]}.

batch2.input_includes: the measured task list (DomainNet classification, CIFAR-10 classification, Mackey-Glass forecasting, Lorenz-63 forecasting, Dyck grammar, tabular regression)
batch2.role: Propose normalisation rules for continuous attributes and eight candidate task pairs/quadruples for similarity positive controls (four known-similar, four known-dissimilar) over the measured axes. Output STRICT JSON only: {"rules": [...], "pairs": [...]}.
